lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p33 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, point and say introduces geometric vocabulary. Students listen to the terms "side" and "corner" and identify them on the large square and triangle illustrations.
Look for accurate pointing to the straight edge when hearing "side" and the vertex when hearing "corner."
